BL-1042 — Article 3.5's host-health throttle is still hand-driven: automate it the way BL-431/432 automated the rework one - but NOT on the existing absolute ratio, which two weeks of live telemetry says would hold intake shut 44.5% of the time
What it solves: ## Call sites confirmed live while scoping
Approval context: The coordinator asked me to "scope automated host-load throttle, mirroring BL-431/432 rework gate". I have, but I found something while measuring that changes what "mirroring" should mean, and I want your eye on it.

THE FINDING. Host-load observation is already live and healthy - 3902 samples over…
BL-1042 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1042" (or "reject BL-1042 <reason>") to act.
